# LIV Plastic Surgery

> Non-surgical anti-aging clinic in Seoul, Korea, focused on lifting and skin-tightening treatments. Located 1 minute from Sinsa Station Exit 4 in the Gangnam area.

LIV Plastic Surgery is led by a board-certified plastic surgeon with SCI-indexed publications. The clinic is an official Ultherapy Prime and Thermage FLX partner. Consultations are available in English, Japanese, and Chinese.

## Clinic facts

- Name: LIV Plastic Surgery (Korean: 리브성형외과 · Japanese: LIV美容クリニック · Chinese: LIV整形外科)
- Address: 4F Jaeun Bldg, 80 Naruteo-ro, Seocho-gu, Seoul 06536, Korea
- Location: 1 minute on foot from Sinsa Station (Line 3) Exit 4, next to Garosu-gil, Gangnam area
- Hours: Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00, Sat 10:00–16:00, closed Sunday (Korea time)
- Phone: +82-2-797-2773
- Focus: non-surgical anti-aging, lifting, and skin tightening
- Languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese; interpretation is arranged free of charge
- Booking from abroad: website live chat, WhatsApp, LINE, WeChat, or the consultation form. No deposit is required to book a consultation.
- Pricing: the price list is public, per session, in Korean won, VAT not included. International patients are charged from the same list as Korean patients.

## Treatments

- Lifting: Ultherapy Prime, Thermage FLX, Density, InMode, ONDA, Shurink, thread lift, APTOS thread lift
- Anti-aging: Botox, filler, skin boosters, skincare programs
- Laser: pigmentation, vascular, skin tone, hair removal
